steps.text: Exactly one person was beside a wine rack. Alma must be beside a wine rack, so nobody else can be beside any wine rack. Eliminated → Celeste: r3c1, r5c1 · Duncan: r3c1, r3c7, r4c8, r5c1, r5c7, r6c8 · Ezra: r3c1, r3c7, r4c8, r5c7, r6c8 · Harriet: r3c1, r3c7, r4c8, r5c1, r5c7, r6c8.

Bruno was alone and can only be in the Billiards, so nobody else can be in the Billiards. Eliminated → Duncan: r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r5c2, r5c3, r6c2, r6c3 · Ezra: r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r5c3, r6c3 · Harriet: r3c2, r3c3, r3c4, r5c2, r5c3, r6c2, r6c3 · Imogen: r5c2, r6c2.

Duncan was south of Bruno. Bruno is in row 3 at the earliest, so Duncan must be in rows 4–9. Eliminated → Duncan: r1c1, r1c3, r1c4, r1c5, r1c7, r1c9, r2c1, r2c2, r2c3, r2c4, r2c5, r2c6, r2c7, r2c8, r2c9, r3c5, r3c6, r3c9.

Harriet was exactly one row south of Imogen. Imogen can only be in rows 1, 2, 7 or 8, which leaves Harriet rows 2, 3, 8 or 9. Eliminated → Harriet: r1c1, r1c3, r1c4, r1c5, r1c7, r1c9, r4c9, r5c9, r6c1, r6c7, r6c9, r7c1, r7c2, r7c3, r7c4, r7c5, r7c8, r7c9.

Jasper was east of Ezra. Jasper can reach column 3 at most, so Ezra must be in columns 1–2. Eliminated → Ezra: r1c3, r1c4, r1c5, r1c7, r2c3, r2c4, r2c5, r2c6, r2c7, r2c8, r3c9, r4c9, r5c9, r6c7, r7c3, r7c5, r7c8, r8c5, r8c6, r8c7, r8c8, r8c9, r9c3, r9c4, r9c5, r9c8, r9c9.

Harriet was alone with someone wearing a hat. Polaroid check — people wearing hats: Bruno, Celeste, Ezra and Gideon. None of them can still reach the Parlor or the Kitchen, so Harriet cannot be there. Eliminated → Harriet: r2c9, r3c5, r3c6, r3c9, r8c9, r9c9.

Ray block: Ezra can only be at r1c1 or r2c1, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Ezra takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on r2c1. Eliminated → Harriet: r2c1.
Harriet was exactly one row south of Imogen. Harriet can only be in rows 2, 8 or 9, which leaves Imogen rows 1, 7 or 8. Eliminated → Imogen: r2c9.
Alma was in a room with no man, and Alma is pinned to the Kitchen, so Duncan cannot be there. Eliminated → Duncan: r6c7.

Harriet was exactly one row south of Imogen. Harriet can only be in rows 8–9, which leaves Imogen rows 7–8. Eliminated → Imogen: r1c9.

Harriet was alone with someone wearing a hat, and Harriet is pinned to the Study: that room holds exactly two people, Harriet and someone wearing a hat. So Duncan cannot be there. Eliminated → Duncan: r7c5, r7c8, r8c5, r8c6, r8c7, r8c8, r9c5, r9c8.

Harriet was alone with someone wearing a hat. Polaroid check — people wearing hats: Bruno, Celeste, Ezra and Gideon. Only Gideon can still share a room with Harriet, so he must be in the Study. Eliminated → Gideon: r7c3, r8c1, r8c2, r8c4, r9c3.
